description_zh: Cruise AV 在传统模式下于 Haight 街与 Gough 街交叉口直行时，被右侧 Gough 街南行的 Vespa 摩托车撞击右后门。选取 AV 为 ego 测试直行过路口时对侧向直行冲突的应对能力，摩托车作为 cross 位置 NPC 以 junction_cross 行为直行穿越。

source_snippets: As the driver of the Cruise AV proceeded on Haight through Gough, a motor scooter, proceeding southbound on Gough through the intersection with Haight, made contact with the right rear passenger door of the Cruise AV
MOVEMENT PRECEDING COLLISION: A. STOPPED (blank), B. PROCEEDING STRAIGHT (VEH 1: X, VEH 2: X)
TYPE OF COLLISION: D. BROADSIDE (VEH 2: X)
WEATHER: A. CLEAR (VEH 1: X, VEH 2: X)
LIGHTING: A. DAYLIGHT (VEH 1: X, VEH 2: X)
evidence.reason: 两车均在移动、直行通过交叉口，摩托车从右侧横穿撞击 ego，构成典型的十字路口直行冲突，现有 junction_cross block 与 cross position 可准确表达。
